stepAnswer: n₁ sin θ₁ = n₂ sin θ₂
n1 sin θ1 = n2 sin θ2
stepExplanation:
Snell's Law describes the relationship between angles of incidence and refraction when light passes between two media:
$$n_1 \sin\theta_1 = n_2 \sin\theta_2$$
where n₁ and n₂ are refractive indices, θ₁ is the angle of incidence, and θ₂ is the angle of refraction.
stepBody: Write down Snell's Law relating the angles and refractive indices.
